name: Dimitrios Papadopoulos
bio:
Dimitrios' journey into motorsport began not on the track, but in his grandfather's metal workshop on the island of Crete. There, amidst the clang of hammers and the scent of oil, he learned the art of shaping metal, a skill he honed over years of meticulous practice. After serving in the Greek Navy as a mechanic, Dimitrios transitioned his expertise to the world of racing, initially working with smaller domestic teams before catching the eye of Alpine's recruiters. 

At Alpine, Dimitrios approaches his role with a blend of old-world craftsmanship and modern technology. He's known for his ability to troubleshoot complex problems, often finding elegant, low-tech solutions where others see only high-tech complexities. His dedication to precision and a near-obsessive attention to detail have earned him the respect of his colleagues. His intuition for metal fatigue and stress points is uncanny, making him an invaluable asset in ensuring the structural integrity of the race cars. He believes that the best fabrication is an art form, where the mind and hands unite to achieve perfection.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Dimitrios is a man of medium build with strong hands, evidence of a lifetime spent working with metal.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to an absurdly fine point.
Mumbles ancient Greek proverbs when deeply focused on a task.
Insists on drinking only Greek mountain tea, even at the track.
